title: [iOS] IrLinkageError: Function 'UIKitView' can not be called
body:
I am using v0.5.5. It is working fine on Android. 
I am unfamiliar with iOS so I'll just give you the full error.
This is the way that I am using:

```
  val state = rememberAdaptiveDatePickerState(
    yearRange = yearsRange ?: IntRange(1922, 2122),
    initialSelectedDateMillis = initialDate.toEpochMilliseconds(),
    initialDisplayedMonthMillis = initialDate.toEpochMilliseconds()
  )

 AdaptiveDatePicker(
    state = state,
    showModeToggle = false
)

```
